verdict.rationale: Logseq documents an official `logseq://x-callback-url/quickCapture` protocol action for "short text and links" that can be saved as a browser bookmark. That gives a first-party, if basic, browser-to-notes capture flow. Its local HTTP API also supports CORS for use from a browser extension, but that only lets users build their own clipper. Missing for 10: an official browser clipper extension, full-page/article content clipping, highlight capture, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the capture flow.
